exposure: Health system goal to reduce maternal morbidity for Black women
Case reviews of Black women meeting morbidity criteria (focus on haemorrhage)
outcome: Maternal morbidity rates among Black women
cohort: The study involved clinicians at 5 inpatient obstetric units and assessed maternal morbidity outcomes among Black women receiving care at these sites.
finding: A health system-wide quality improvement initiative, including data-driven collaborative interventions tailored to sites, was associated with a significant 29.4% reduction in maternal morbidity for Black women overall.
